title: ר' חנניה בר אחוי דר' הושעיה
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: R. Chananyah, son of R. Hoshaya's brother. R. [name not supplied] said to R. Chananyah, son of R. Hoshaya's brother, “Do you remember when we were passing before the shop of R. Hoshaya, your uncle? R. Ba bar Zavda passed, and we asked them, and he said in Rav's name, etc.”: Jerusalem Megillah 3:7 in the checked edition. See R. Yosi son of R. Chanina; one of the places has a scribal error. Taanit, chapter 1, halakhah 2: R. Yasa said to R. Chananyah, Rav Hoshaya's brother, “Do you remember when we stood before the shop of Rav Hoshaya, your uncle? R. Zeira passed, and we asked him, etc.; R. Yasa passed, and we asked them, etc.” It is a scribal error and should read “to R. Chananyah, son of his brother.” This is certainly not the R. Chananyah, son of R. Yehoshua's brother, mentioned immediately above, because R. Abba bar Zavda and R. Zeira did not live in his days.
